tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Completed the requested registration for Kane Tester using kanentz83z@mlyfo.app and the username kanentz83z.
Confirmed that @kanentz83z was available before creating the account.
Created the account successfully and reached the welcome page for Kane.
The new account wallet balance is $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner ntz83z” with a total of $236 and participants zoya, kabir, and sofia.
The split was calculated as 4 people at $59.00 each.
The new split is listed as “1 of 4 paid.”
Each of zoya, kabir, and sofia has a $59.00 amount and a Copy link button.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in, open the Shield page, and check the provided Solana address.
Signed in and opened the Shield page.
Entered the provided address and checked it.
The address was marked “Blocked,” with a warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
Requested a $150 rent payment to @ada using the message “pay @ada 150 for rent.”
Entered the payment request and selected “Pay $150.00.”
The confirmation showed that the amount exceeded both the $100 per-payment limit and the $25 limit for new recipients.
Entered the password and confirmed the payment.
The payment was completed and the page confirmed “Sent $150.00 to @ada.”

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
Entered https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim into the link checker and ran a quick check.
The check marked the link as Dangerous.
The results explained that the address imitates Phantom but is not the real site.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Attempted to add a person named “Ada new” with the provided Solana address.
Saved the person form on the People page.
The page reported that the address was not saved because it looked like Ada’s saved address but was not.
“Ada new” was not added to the list of people.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
You asked to send $5.00 to Semi for coffee.
Entered “pay semi 5 for coffee” and selected the $5.00 payment option.
The page asked which Semi you meant and showed both your contact Semi and the Mlyfo user @semi.
Selected your contact Semi, and the payment was confirmed as sent.

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity.
Confirmed the payment receipt shows $10.00 paid to @kabir.
The receipt ID is MLY-64DZ-KZWY.
